messages:
Alex R.: Heads up — planned SLO-tiering migration + canary failover test this Friday 2026-03-27 02:00-05:00 UTC. This is a controlled exercise to move some routes to the new SLO tier controller and validate graceful fallbacks. Hosted API unimpacted; affects Dedicated pools in eu-west-1 and us-west-2.

Maya S.: Is this a hard cutover or staged? Any expected user-facing errors? :thinking_face:

Alex R.: Staged. We'll do 3 canary waves: 02:00, 03:15, 04:15 UTC. Each wave targets ~5% of traffic for the two regions, 15m observe windows. Expect brief p99 latency bumps (~+50–150ms) and some per-route concurrency throttles. No auth changes.

Kevin L.: Will automatic fallbacks route to the smaller model variants if a node trips? Want to confirm fallback policy config.

Alex R.: Yes — fallback policy is enabled: route -> same model family (quantized variant) -> model-small. If both fail, we spill to region-wider fallback (non-dedicated). The playbook is here: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/slo-tiering-failover (read-only).

SRE Ops Bot: Scheduled maintenance created: https://internal/maintenance/2271000001 — state: scheduled, owner: @Alex R., notify: oncall, slack_channel: #eng-sre

Julia P.: Heads-up: we have an enterprise customer migration in us-west-2 around 03:30 UTC. Can we exclude their org-id from canaries?

Alex R.: Good catch. Yes — we added an exclusion list. Please DM me the org-id if you want to double-check.

Oncall Robin: I'll be on-call that window. Quick checklist: 1) confirm alert routing to PagerDuty 2) pre-warm KV cache prefixes 3) ensure read replicas healthy.

Alex R.: Thanks — checklist:
```
- pd escalation policy: SLO-Migration-PD
- run prewarm: curl -XPOST https://infra/api/prewarm -d '{"prefixes": ["/org/", "/route/"]}'
- enable debug tracing if p99 > 2s: set TRACE=1 on region agents
```

Maya S.: Can we add a short rule to the rollout: if error rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive mins, rollback that wave automatically?

Kevin L.: That's in the canary policy but double-checking: auto-rollback is enabled, threshold = 0.5% errors OR p99 > 2s, 3-minute window.

Julia P.: Thanks — confirming enterprise org excluded. Also firing a brief customer comms note to CS just in case.

Alex R.: Final notes: please keep channels clear during the 15m observe windows; use thread to report status. We will post a brief summary after the run. cc @Oncall Robin @Maya S. :thumbsup:

Oncall Robin: Roger. I'll post run status updates here (started / wave1 OK / wave2 rollback / finished).

SRE Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled 1 hour before window.
